desc: Parse p by splitting on '*' into segments A, B, C and handle the all-empty "**" case (return 0).
Implement all-occurrence collection for each non-empty segment using KMP (O(n+m), handles overlaps).
Build latestA[x] (running prefix max of A-starts ending <= x) and nextC[x] (suffix min of C-starts >= x) arrays of size n+1.
For non-empty B: iterate its occurrences, compute best start (b0 if A empty else latestA[b0]) and best end (b1 if C empty else nextC[b1]+len(C)), skip invalid ones, track min span.
For empty B: handle A*C with both non-empty via latestA over C occurrences, and single-segment cases "*C"->lenC / "A*"->lenA when the segment occurs, else -1.
Return -1 if no valid match found; verified all four provided examples produce 8, -1, 0, 6.
